stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 23.

In a nanosecond I had to decide whether to tell the truth and risk losing a potential friend, or lie and live with the consequences.

Which characteristic of realistic fiction is most evident in this sentence?

options.label: F
options.text: The setting is in a real or true-to-life location.

options.label: G
options.text: The story occurs in a contemporary or near-present time period.

options.label: H
options.text: The events raise questions that a reader could possibly face in everyday life.

options.label: J
options.text: The narrative structure is presented with a definite beginning, middle, and end.

visual_elements: In a nanosecond I had to decide whether to tell the truth and risk losing a potential friend, or lie and live with the consequences.
